name: session-create-login-not-ssh-422

graded_by.test: core/internal/session/create_test.go — TestALoginOnATelnetOrEchoTargetIsRefusedBeforeAnyWorker: 422 invalid_request, and no worker is asked for anything

description: A login on a target whose type is not ssh is refused 422 invalid_request, before any worker is asked: a telnet login is typed inside the session and recorded verbatim, and a telnet connect refuses user and auth, so the core never turns a login into a connect for one. The same for echo and serial targets. Needs a target of one of those types that the principal can see and may create on (input target_id, a telnet target). No live fixture names a non-ssh target, and the contract's stub provider answers create at 201 for any target it knows, so this one is graded by the core's own test.

error.message: a login is for ssh targets only
